title: MineboundSMP
description: Enhanced vanilla survival with QoL tweaks, better performance and a seamless SMP experience.
body:
**MineboundSMP** is a refined, vanilla focused survival experience built for players who want smoother gameplay, smarter quality of life improvements and a world that feels alive without ever losing the charm of classic Minecraft. Every addition is intentional with lightweight enhancements, performance boosts and subtle mechanics that elevate survival without overwhelming it.

This pack strengthens the core SMP loop of exploring, building, collaborating and thriving while keeping the gameplay familiar and accessible. Expect cleaner visuals, improved optimisation, smarter UI elements and small but meaningful tweaks that make everyday tasks more intuitive. Whether you're mining deep underground, building a base with friends or embarking on long distance adventures, MineboundSMP ensures the world feels responsive, polished and immersive.

Designed for long‑term worlds, community servers and players who value stability, MineboundSMP avoids unnecessary complexity and instead focuses on delivering a smooth, modernised vanilla experience. It’s Minecraft the way it should feel. Faster, clearer, more connected and more rewarding all while staying true to the game’s original spirit.
